game_title: Strip And Replace – Cliffside Ledge Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Frost Peaks – Cliffside Ledge, a narrow cliff ledge: the sherpa guide must handle snow leopards while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Strip And Replace: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it.
theme: Frost Peaks – Cliffside Ledge: a narrow cliff ledge
core_gameplay_loop: In Cliffside Ledge, repeat each round: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it. Each round, snow leopards strike the basecamp tent, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the clean_text value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the basecamp tent from snow leopards in Cliffside Ledge: keep the clean_text meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 54-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: clean_text drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 54-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 9 (extended tier): Strip And Replace
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clean_text changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow leopards in Cliffside Ledge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 54 seconds while clean_text > 0.
